subject: content(quests): Level 1000 quest - Build a PXE Boot Server
body:
"Summon Machines From the Wire" covers the network boot chain (PXE,
DHCP options 60/77/93/175, TFTP, UEFI HTTP Boot, iPXE chain-loading and
its loop), a QEMU lab that boots the Debian installer in BIOS and UEFI
mode, ProxyDHCP on a real LAN, a failure field guide, security, and
lessons from building one-usb's netboot server with Claude Code.

The lab was run end to end for this quest; the four screenshots are
real QEMU captures. Quest data regenerated with make quest-data.

subject: docs(setup): record AUTO_PR_GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and rotation
body:
Issue Autopilot's resolve legs have failed at actions/checkout on every
scheduled run since 2026-10-31: AUTO_PR_GITHUB_TOKEN is set but rejected,
and the presence-only || chain never falls through (bamr87/bamr87#761).
A new PAT can only be minted in GitHub's web settings by the owner, and
nothing recorded what it must be allowed to do.

docs/setup/AUTO_PR_TOKEN.md records the fine-grained token the resolve
job needs (bamr87/it-journey only; Contents, Pull requests and Issues
read and write), what each of the ten other workflows that read the same
secret does with it, the two optional permissions two of them can use
(Actions for pr-freshness's re-dispatch, Workflows for Dependabot
workflow bumps), and the owner's procedure for storing the value from
the clipboard without echoing it. The docs index is regenerated with
tools/docs_index.py.

No secret value appears anywhere in this change.

Refs bamr87/bamr87#761

author: bamr87
subject: content(quests): forge epic quest — The Silent Network
body:
A five-chapter epic (level 1010 hub, 440 XP total) drawn from a real
debugging session: installing SteamOS on an X870E desktop whose Wi-Fi
has no driver in the shipped kernel, so first boot stops NetworkManager
and never restarts it ("No networks found", ValveSoftware/SteamOS#2514).

- I   The Wrong Throne: which disk did you boot? (findmnt, efibootmgr, A/B slots)
- II  The Deaf Gatekeeper: a ProxyDHCP thread that died while status said "running"
- III The Rescue Lantern: SSH into a rescue system, read an install's journal offline
- IV  The Silencing Script: root cause, the false fix, a guard unit seeded into /etc
- V   The Molten Core: drivers vs kernels, why DKMS is a trap, update channels

Also adds the bestiary/artifact entries to the codex glossary, a row in
the codex index, and regenerates the quest navigation and network data.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

subject: ci(harness): bring the AI workflows onto the fleet harness standard

Grade ten AI workflows ON STANDARD against the hub's harness standard
(bamr87/bamr87 _data/fleet.yml harnesses.standard) and bind what can bind
on the link checker.

- claude-run lanes: add the turn cap (max-turns) and the job timeout each
  one was missing. The issue triager's cap is sized from this repo's
  ai-usage records (25 calls, 5-9 turns -> 20); every other cap is the
  fleet's rule for a lane with no metered run (60 under the $10 cap).
- issue-autopilot: the autopilot:go label starts a run only when the
  person who applied it has write access to the repo.
- cms-daily-loop: the bare `claude -p` becomes the claude-run step (same
  prompt, tools, model, turn cap; adds the $10 cap, the repo's credential
  order and metering); the git/gh block moves to the runner's user
  settings; CMS_DAILY_LOOP_ENABLED kill switch (default on).
- link-checker: cron off the hour (23 6 * * 1), LINK_CHECKER_ENABLED kill
  switch (default on). Its optional model call is left as it is.
- Regenerate docs/reference/workflows.md; update the workflows README.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: bamr87
subject: fix(quest-validator): prefer OAuth over the API key in the agentic runner
body:
The agentic quest review has scored 0 quests on every PR since 2026-10-27
(PR #933 is the latest). The workflow hands the runner both
CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, and the claude CLI prefers
the API key when both are set, so a rejected key shadowed the OAuth token.
The step is continue-on-error, so the check stayed green and the PR comment
showed an empty table with no warning.

- runner: give each claude call one credential, OAuth first, and fall back
  to the API key only when OAuth is refused (auth or quota). A refused
  credential is skipped for the rest of the batch; a backend overload does
  not switch credentials. QUEST_QA_AUTH_ORDER / AI_AUTH_ORDER override the
  order, matching the fleet claude-run contract.
- runner: auth errors quote what each credential's CLI call said
  (secrets scrubbed) with a fix per credential; record which credential
  served each quest (meta.auth) and the preflight probe.
- agentic_validate: skip explicitly passed files that are not playable
  quests (same is_quest rule as discovery); annotate the Actions run with
  ::error / ::warning when credentials or throttling stop the batch.
- report: an "Incomplete review" banner with the reason replaces the empty
  table on truncated runs; the headline names the credential used.
- tests: credential order, fallback, stickiness, scrubbing, preflight,
  banner, and the non-quest skip.
- README: correct the claim that the CLI treats ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as a
  fallback, and the stale CI s…

author: bamr87
subject: fix(about): publish the versioning page at /about/versioning/
body:
The page had no permalink and categories: [posts], so the collection
pattern /:collection/:categories/:name/ built it at
/about/posts/versioning/ and /about/versioning/ returned 404. Its copy
still described a blog, a retropie example, a _docs folder, manual tag
pushes and a tag-triggered deploy, none of which match the site today.

- Frontmatter: permalink /about/versioning/, redirect_from the URL that
  works today (/about/posts/versioning/), categories [about], tags and
  keywords for release-please, and a fresh description and lastmod.
- Copy rewritten for the quest site: Conventional Commits on every PR;
  release-please (release.yml) keeps the release PR, tags vX.Y.Z and
  publishes the GitHub release; which commit types move which number,
  per release-please-config.json (breaking changes move MINOR while the
  major version is 0; hidden types never release on their own); the
  generated CHANGELOG.md is never edited by hand; the site deploys from
  main, not from tags; the zer0-mistakes theme is versioned in its own
  repository and loaded as an unpinned remote_theme. No version number
  is hard-coded: the page links CHANGELOG.md and the releases page.
- /about/ links the changelog and the versioning page from "Where
  we're headed", so the page is no longer an orphan, and the about
  folder README lists it under Key Pages.

Refs #881

author: bamr87
subject: chore(astro): add Astro migration spike for the quests collection
body:
A time-boxed test of whether it-journey.dev can move off Jekyll without touching its content. The project in astro/ builds every published page in pages/_quests straight from the Markdown Jekyll reads, in a new quest-first layout. Nothing under pages/ is edited and nothing here is deployed.

- astro/: loader that reads pages/_quests in place, a translation layer for Jekyll and kramdown syntax (raw blocks, details, attribute lists, wikilinks, relative links), quest, level, hub and document templates, design tokens with light and dark pairs, and progress stored under the same localStorage key and shape as the Jekyll site.
- astro/scripts/url-parity.mjs: compares the built URLs with a Jekyll sitemap.
- _config.yml: exclude astro/ from the Jekyll build.
- TODO/screenshots/astro-spike/: before and after screenshots at 390px and 1440px.
- .claude/launch.json: preview configurations for the spike.

Results: 255 of 258 files load (the other three are left out as Jekyll leaves them out), and 323 of 324 URLs under /quests/ match a Jekyll build of the same commit. The one missing, /quests/ideas/, comes from a page outside the collection. 12 unit tests and the type check pass; the Jekyll CI build and make content-audit still pass with astro/ excluded.

Not covered: the other collections, search, comments, consent, feeds and sitemap, heading-anchor parity, and any Makefile, CI or deploy wiring. See astro/README.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: bamr87
subject: chore(astro): escape backslashes in wikilink labels
body:
CodeQL (js/incomplete-sanitization) flagged the label escaping in the wikilink translation: it escaped brackets but not the backslash, so a label ending in a backslash would escape the closing bracket and break the generated Markdown link.

Escape the backslash as well and add a unit test for it. No page in pages/ has a backslash inside a wikilink today, and the built output is byte-identical before and after.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
